changelog: The voice keyboard now understands spoken punctuation, like the main app has since v4.7: with the 'Spoken punctuation' switch on in Settings, say দাঁড়ি, কমা, প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন or নতুন লাইন while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and it types । , ? or a new line instead of the literal word (English: period, comma, question mark, new line work the same). Off by default, because দাঁড়ি also means 'beard'.
